																Educational Degree: Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree, or Doctorate Degree from a recognized University or Institution in any of the following streams:

																
																	
																	Food Technology Disciplines: Food Engineering, Food Processing & Preservation, Food Technology & Management, Food Biotechnology, Food Safety & Quality Management (or Related Subject).

																Selection Process:  Selection on the Basis of Screening Test followed by Subject Knowledge Test and Interview.
